name: Set up my existing Chat App

messages.content:
Set up my existing Chat App frontend and backend with a professional, scalable architecture.

Frontend: React.js, Tailwind CSS, React Router, Axios, responsive UI, reusable components, authentication and protected routes.

Backend: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT authentication, Socket.IO for real-time messaging, REST APIs, and secure middleware.

Create a clean folder structure, configure environment variables, connect frontend with backend, and implement proper error handling. Ensure fast performance, secure authentication, and smooth real-time communication.

Do not break existing features or rewrite the project unnecessarily.

Implement a complete authentication system in my existing Chat App.

- User Registration and Login
- JWT access and refresh tokens
- Secure password hashing using bcrypt
- Email OTP verification during registration
- Forgot and Reset Password
- Logout functionality
- Protected routes and persistent login
- Form validation and error handling

Connect frontend with backend APIs and MongoDB. Ensure fast authentication, secure sessions, and correct navigation after login. Do not break existing code.
